uzo.purpose: Hides secondary content behind a label the person can open; several share a group when only one should be open.

instead.kialo: Views of the same thing that a person switches between are tabs, because one of them is always shown and the others wait beside it; a disclosure hides its content until it is opened.
What everyone has to read is not hidden, because a closed disclosure is skipped; it stands as running text on the page.

boundary.kialo: A disclosure inside a disclosure hides content two levels deep, because a person has to open twice to find it; a person decides whether the inner level is a section of the page instead.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A disclosure stands in the flow of a section, because its content belongs there once it is opened.

with.kialo: Disclosures of one group are separated by a line, because a line says where one entry ends and the next begins.
The summary shows a chevron that turns with the state, because the sign says that there is more and whether it is shown.
The content of a disclosure is running text in its roles, because what it hides is read once opened.

case.de: Die Person wechselt zwischen Ansichten desselben Dings, von denen immer eine zu sehen ist.
case.en: The person switches between views of the same thing, one of which is always shown.

case.de: Jeder muss den Inhalt lesen, er darf also nicht verborgen sein.
case.en: Everyone has to read the content, so it must not be hidden.

do.de: Lass die Zusammenfassung sagen, was hinter ihr steht.
do.en: Let the summary say what lies behind it.

do.de: Gib mehreren Abschnitten dieselbe group, wenn immer nur einer offen sein soll.
do.en: Give several sections the same group when only one should be open at a time.

do.de: Nenne bei disabled den Grund, damit der Abschnitt erreichbar bleibt und sagt, warum er zu ist.
do.en: Give the reason with disabled, so the section stays reachable and says why it is closed.

dont.de: Einen Abschnitt in einen zweiten schachteln, denn dann muss die Person zweimal öffnen.
dont.en: Nest one section in another, because then the person has to open twice.

dont.de: Pflichtangaben oder Fehler hinter einer geschlossenen Zusammenfassung verstecken.
dont.en: Hide required information or errors behind a closed summary.

action.de: Öffnet oder schließt den Inhalt, wenn die Zusammenfassung den Fokus hat; bei disabled geschieht nichts.
action.en: Opens or closes the content while the summary has the focus; with disabled nothing happens.
